sets.relationshipLabel: worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A surgeon wields a scalpel just as a phlebotomist wields a needle — each pair links a medical worker to the single instrument that defines their job.

sets.relationshipLabel: start and end of a medical span
sets.explanation: Onset leads to remission and admission leads to discharge — each pair marks the opening and closing bookend of a clinical episode.

sets.relationshipLabel: a cover and the true thing hidden beneath it
sets.explanation: A bandage hides a wound and a cast hides a fracture — each pair is a visible covering standing in for the injury it conceals.

sets.relationshipLabel: the device that lets a bodily process continue
sets.explanation: A stent keeps blood flowing and a pacemaker keeps the heart beating — each device doesn't just touch the body part, it causally sustains its function.
